chapter_title_en: The Peony Festival of the Divine Capital
chapter_seo_title: Xiao Chen Enters Nirvana and Faces Old Enemies at Luoyang
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen stabilizes his Nirvana cultivation with seventy-two acupoints, while Keke begins her third transformation. At the Peony Gathering in Luoyang, he meets old rivals and new threats.
og_title: Xiao Chen's Nirvana Breakthrough and the Luoyang Peony Gathering
og_description: Xiao Chen refines a spirit pill, reaching a stable Nirvana realm with seventy-two divine acupoints. Keke's fur turns gold as her power grows. In Luoyang, cultivators from two worlds converge for the Peony Festival.
twitter_title: Nirvana Stabilized, Keke's Third Transformation Begins
twitter_description: Xiao Chen gains seventy-two acupoints and enters Nirvana without a low period. Keke shows golden fur. Luoyang hosts a gathering of mortal and immortal cultivators.
